title: A Mysterious New Class of X-Ray Objects Was Found
mediaSource: Chandra mysterious X-ray objects ultraviolet galaxies 2026 NASA

scenes.title: Astronomers found objects unlike anything seen before
scenes.narration: NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory has revealed a group of objects that do not fit neatly into existing astronomical categories.

scenes.title: Weak X-rays but intense ultraviolet light
scenes.narration: The objects emit unusually low-energy X-rays while shining extremely brightly in ultraviolet light, a combination that surprised researchers.

scenes.title: They appeared in more than one galaxy
scenes.narration: Researchers found similar sources in multiple galaxies, including M101, suggesting this may be a real new population rather than a single odd object.

scenes.title: Their identity is still unknown
scenes.narration: White dwarfs or neutron stars may be involved, but current models do not fully reproduce the strange combination of observed signals.

scenes.title: They may connect two old astrophysics mysteries
scenes.narration: Scientists think these objects could help explain unusual ultraviolet and X-ray emission seen in certain galaxies.

scenes.title: The universe still has objects without a name
scenes.narration: Even after decades of classifying stars and galaxies, astronomers are still finding entire groups of objects that do not fit the old boxes.
